appBugs.title: הפרעת 'דיו' מפילה את האפליקציה של היעד: מסך כהה וריק, ונטישה
appBugs.what: Build: apk12, 1.1.0 (08.11 23:53, loop-6 fixes), SM-A165F, Android 16, Hebrew, staging. Steps: two phones in a ranked 2p fast game. The sender is level 3 or higher (אורי, level 9) and has 2+ points. On the sender, tap 'הפרעה' on the opponent's card, then 'דיו'. Result: about 2 s later the receiver's app (אחוותא) turns to a blank dark screen with only the status bar: no banner, no board. The JS runtime is destroyed. Logcat on the receiver, 02:05:26.703: ReactHost.handleHostException 'ReferenceError: Property 'INK' doesn't exist at inkPose_inkModelTs1 (:1:54) at InkTsx2 at reactNativeReanimated_useDerivedValueTs1 at mapperRun ...', then 'Starting React Native destruction'. Cause: apps/mobile/src/components/interference/inkModel.ts, inkPose() is a 'worklet' whose default params (splatMs = INK.splatMs, fadeMs = INK.fadeMs) read the module constant INK, which is not captured on the UI runtime in Release. After 25 s the sender gets 'אחוותא עזב את המשחק · ניצחת בנטישה' (+8). The receiver loses 8 rating and has to kill and relaunch the app. Log: docs/handoff/2026-11-03/data/crash-RF8Y30L038L-interference-new-ink-look.txt. The ink hit is unusable for every receiver, and the ink tasks, avatars-react-hit-target/sender and new-fps are blocked by it.

appBugs.title: Hit banner ring number freezes on '2' for ~1.7 s, and '1' shows for only ~0.3 s
appBugs.what: Build apk12, Hebrew, SM-A165F. Friends room, 2 players. The sender launches fireworks. appBugs.title: The opponent-freeze countdown stops at 1, and the 'הזמן נגמר / בודקים מול השרת…' stage never shows
appBugs.what: Build 1.1.0 apk12 (08.11 23:53), SM-A165F, Hebrew. 2-player friends room set to 'מהיר' (phone A hosts, phone B joins with the code). Mid-game, turn on airplane mode on B with Wi-Fi off, and leave it on for 40 s. On A: about 10 s of only the orange dot and Wi-Fi icon, then 'היריב מתנתק…' with the 'Reconnecting... 15' ring counting down. Screen recording on A, frames read every 0.1 s: the ring stays on '1' for about 1 s and then cross-fades in about 0.2 s straight to 'אחוותא עזב את המשחק / ניצחת בנטישה / הזמן נגמר • 25 שניות בלי חיבור'. '0' never shows, and neither does the 'הזמן נגמר' + 'בודקים מול השרת…' state. Likely cause: the server's abandon message arrives about 1 s before the client's local countdown reaches 0. Either the local count runs about 1 s behind the server deadline, or the interim state only shows when the server is late.

appBugs.title: אחרי שהאפליקציה נהרגת באמצע משחק עם חברים, אי אפשר לחזור: 4002 ואז 'לא חזרת למשחק בזמן'
appBugs.what: Build apk12, 1.1.0 (08.11 23:53, loop-6 fixes, startup log), on two SM-A165F phones (Android 16, Hebrew), staging. Steps: (1) Phone A creates a friends room ('קשה') and phone B joins with the code. A taps 'התחל משחק · 2 שחקנים' and the board shows on both. (2) On B, open the recent apps list and swipe the app away, so the process dies (it gets a new pid). Relaunch it within about 7 s. Result: the screen shows 'חדר עם חברים' · 'מצטרף לחדר…'. Logcat shows 'Room connection was closed unexpectedly (4002)' three times, about 0 s, 4 s and 10 s after the relaunch (CloseCode.WITH_ERROR). Then the results screen shows 'הפסד', 'איך זה נגמר: לא חזרת למשחק בזמן'. On A, the opponent's card shows 'נטש', and A later gets the win. Expected: the player returns to the same game (friends-manage-block-mid-game). It happens without any block (a control game). It happens the same way when phone A is killed (after it blocked B mid-game). It also happened when the app was opened again with its process still alive: that time it returned fine. So only a real process kill fails. Logs: qa-shots/RF8Y30L038L-friends-manage-block-mid-game-logcat.txt, qa-shots/RF8Y30L038L-friends-manage-block-mid-game-logcat-1.txt, qa-shots/RF8Y60PP2XZ-friends-manage-block-mid-game-logcat.txt (in the run's scratchpad).

catalogIssues.issue: השלב והשורה הצפויה מניחים שני חשבונות חדשים עם 1200 'זמני' (1232/1168, K=64, שורת 'דירוג זמני'). בהרצה בלי התחברות אי אפשר לבדוק את זה. כדאי לנסח את השורה כך: 'לפי נוסחת Elo מהדירוגים שלפני המשחק', ולהוסיף דרישה שהספרות יופיעו על המסך בלי גלילה.
גם כאן הערכים 1168/1232 דורשים חשבונות חדשים. בין חשבונות ותיקים השינוי הוא Elo עם K=32 (כאן ⁦−6⁩/⁦+6⁩).
המשימה דורשת fake-client עם Gil ו־--token, ואין טוקנים. נבדק מול טלפון 3 כיריב שנכנע.

בתסריט, טלפון א' (אורי, 1310) צריך לנצח את 1021, אבל פער הדירוג 289 קרוב לתקרה של ±300. ניצחון של אורי ועוד ניצחון במשחק 2 היו מעבירים את הפער את 300, ואז שני הטלפונים לא היו נפגשים יותר. לכן במשחק 1 טלפון 3 ניצח. כדאי שהתסריט ירשום את הדירוגים ויחליט מי ינצח לפי הפער.
מ'מצא יריב' עד המשחק זה לקח כ־50 שניות. בגלל הפער (כ־230–290) אף פעם לא הגיע בוט, כי השני נמצא בטווח המקסימלי. הצילום ברגע GO, וגם gfxinfo reset, צריכים לכן לחכות כ־50 שניות ולא 8–20.

✓2 (locked kinds dimmed with 'רמה N') can't be judged with these two accounts (levels 9 and 6, unlock levels 2/3/4). The task needs a level-1 to level-3 account, which only comes from a fresh account (login).
The steps (and those of the other interference-new-* tasks) still describe a Development Build, dev:lan and fake-client --rules. This round used a real sender on staging from the picker.

Release has no Perf Monitor. gfxinfo 'Total frames rendered' on this app counts several surfaces (1100–1340 frames in about 8 s, more than 90 Hz), so 'frames ÷ 5 s' is meaningless. The check needs a different measure, for example SurfaceFlinger queueBuffer fps of the main window, or a video review.

'בודקים מול השרת…' did not show in either direction, with frames every 0.75 s: the ring goes from 1 straight to the abandon dialog. If that step only shows when the server is slow, the expected line should say 'ייתכן'. Also, the 'orange dot' is in fact an orange wifi-off icon where the interfere button was.
On the receiver, the hit banner covers the receiver's own avatar for most of the hit, so 'בטלפון ב' (בכרטיס שלי)' can be seen only in the last moments of the hit.
In an English UI dump the given-cell description ends in 'given' (e.g. 'A3, 3, given'), not 'רמז'. Script step 9 and the task's step 3 should say so.
Same as givens-normal: the dump word is 'רמז' only in Hebrew, 'given' in English.

With the stealth bot on (STEALTH_BOT_HIDE_NOBODY), the 2p 'alone' notice never shows. A lone search shows the 'טווח דירוג' bar instead, and a persona is seated within seconds. All tasks that rely on the 2p notice (search-alone, bot-from-notice, other-type, search-join step 2, search-english ✓2, timeout-*) can only run with the bot off. The same notice can be seen in the 4p queue, which the stealth bot does not enter.

✓2 'ובהמשך המסך נמנעים מיריבים ששיחקת מולם לאחרונה': on a 1080x2340 A16 this line is below the fold when the range card is shown, hidden behind the 'ביטול חיפוש' footer, so it is visible only after scrolling. It is visible without scrolling only in the 'מתחבר לתור…' state.
✓2 allows Hebrew only in the opponent's name, but my own name (אורי) is also Hebrew on the card. It should say 'חוץ משמות השחקנים'.
✓4 'אין אף מילה בעברית': the user's own display name (אורי) sits next to the avatar in the header. It should exclude user names.
✓1 needs a pair that has not played recently. The two test accounts (אורי, אחוותא) always show 'שיחקתם זה מול זה לאחרונה'. In 'רגיל' too, where the line is per game type.
Step 2 'מחכים להודעה כרגע אין שחקנים אחרים…' cannot happen while the stealth bot is on. Searching the same type within 2 s still checks ✓1.

The expected lines name 'Fake1' (a fake client), but this session uses the second phone as the target. Also, 'נקודה כתומה' does not match the app: the offline dot is amber-yellow (#FFCF3F, the same color as the Wi-Fi circle), not orange. Suggest 'נקודה צהובה־כתומה (אזהרה)'.
The expected lines call the disconnecting player ב', while the session script disconnects A (טלפון 3) and watches on B. The roles should match the setup.
✓2 needs a level-1 account. Neither phone has one (אחוותא is now level 6), and switching accounts is forbidden, so with the current test accounts this can only be checked by Moshe with a new account.
The whole task needs a level-1 sender. אחוותא is level 6, so tapping the 'locked' kinds would launch them. Mark it as a Moshe/new-account task, or keep a level-1 test account.

On Android 16, gfxinfo prints both 'Janky frames' (new metric; here 0%) and 'Janky frames (legacy)' (here 76–90%). The ✓ should say which line counts, and maybe add a p90 limit: p90 was 42–69 ms while Janky was 0%.

The toast said 'בעוד 5 שניות' already ~1.6 s after the launch, while the hit lasts 5 s. If the cooldown is meant to be the remaining hit time, the expected line should say how N is computed, or this is an app issue. Not marked as a failure.

The expected line 'הספירה של אותה נעילה מראה אותו מספר שניות בשני הטלפונים' cannot be read literally: on the other phone a rival's lock shows only the rival's avatar in the cell, with no seconds number. Suggest checking 'the lock lasts 8 s and ends at the same moment on both phones', or the 'בוחר <cell>' ring on the rival's card.

Lines 2–3 ('down to 0', then 'הזמן נגמר' with 'בודקים מול השרת…') depend on timing. If the server's abandon decision arrives before the local count reaches 0, the app goes straight from 'Reconnecting... 1' to the 'עזב את המשחק' screen. If that is acceptable, the task should say so, the way network-abandon-leaver lists two valid outcomes.

'הספרה הממתינה נשארת על הלוח, מתחת למסך': the 'הלוח נעול עד שתחזור' card covers rows C–E, so a pending digit there cannot be seen at all. The line can only be judged by the digit being counted after the return. Suggest telling the tester to put the pending digit in row A, B or F–I.

Step 4 ('לוחצים על משבצת ריקה ומקישים בה ספרה') together with ✓1 (the lock with its countdown): when the digit follows the tap within about 0.3 s, the lock strip 'המשבצת שלך X · 8 שניות' shows only for a moment. The task could say to wait about 2 s before typing the digit.

The expected line says 'לא מצאנו חדר עם הקוד הזה.' (friends:notFoundThis, the link variant). When the code is typed, the app shows 'לא מצאנו חדר עם הקוד ⁦XXX XXX⁩. בדוק את הספרות.' (friends:notFound). That is the same as a wrong code, which is what the task means. The wording should match the typed-code message.

Step 3 says to open phone B's card from history. In 1.1.0 a history card opens 'צפייה חוזרת', where the player cards can't be tapped, so there is no card or block there. Pressing back from the room leaves it, so you can't go to Home → history without leaving. I opened the card with the deep link sudokufight://player/<id> over the room. The step needs another way: a ranked game's results, the leaderboard, or a link.

Steps 5–6 (swipe away from recents) depend on the friends-room rejoin after a process kill, which fails in general (see appBugs). Note for Claude runs: on this Samsung in Hebrew, the recents list shows the current app at the LEFT edge, and the centre card is another app.
Step 2 says to choose 'מהיר', but the session script plays the 'קשה' room. I checked it in 'קשה'. The texts do not depend on the game type.

The session script says the 'עוד סיבוב' line should read 'אימון לבד · לוח מלא', but the app shows 'אימון לבד · מהיר' (the type, not the mode subtitle). The task itself says to write down whatever is shown, so it was judged that way.

The expected line quotes 'עם חברים · בלי דירוג' as one phrase. The card shows 'ניצחון · עם חברים · מהיר' on one line and 'בלי דירוג' on another. Both phrases are there, so it passed. The wording could match the card.

Example name 'Dana' in the expected lines. Without a third player (fake-client) the task cannot run: with only 2 players and B in the background, 'התחל משחק' is disabled, so the dialog never appears. The same is true for start-without-closed. Both need ID tokens.

Expected line 1 ('the button on the rival card says Interfere') conflicts with the loop-6 design: on a 2P card that is too narrow (for example, rival status 'Thinking…'), the button is icon-only and the word is only in the accessible label. The line should say 'the button's accessible label is Interfere with <name>…, or the word Interfere when it fits'. Step 3 also says the room button is 'צור חדר', but in English it is 'New room'.

Step 2 says to tap Back 'while פותח חדר…' is shown. On Wi-Fi, the screen captured about 0.1 s after the tap already shows 'מצטרף לחדר…' (create is finished and the app is joining), so 'פותח חדר…' is hard to catch. Suggest: 'while the spinner (פותח חדר… / מצטרף לחדר…) is shown'.

Neither test account (אורי, אחוותא) can meet the precondition. Both have a Hard row on the leaderboard (1232 and 1200, both provisional), and אחוותא's 1200 may be a default rating rather than a played game. The message can be checked only with a new account. If the server lists accounts that never played Hard at 1200, the task can never trigger for an existing account.
